title: PayPal Payments
description: Your PayPal app's credentials. Make an app at developer.paypal.com, add a webhook to it that points at /commerce/webhook/paypal on this site, then switch PayPal on in Settings → Commerce.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Sandbox takes no real money: use it with PayPal's sandbox accounts until your store works end to end. Live charges real accounts.

sandboxClientId.label: Sandbox Client ID
sandboxClientId.help: From developer.paypal.com, under Apps & Credentials, with Sandbox selected.

sandboxClientSecret.label: Sandbox Secret
sandboxClientSecret.help: The secret shown beside the sandbox Client ID.

sandboxWebhookId.label: Sandbox Webhook ID
sandboxWebhookId.help: Shown when you add a webhook to the sandbox app. PayPal is asked to check every event against it, and an event that does not check out is refused.

liveClientId.label: Live Client ID
liveClientId.help: From developer.paypal.com, under Apps & Credentials, with Live selected.

liveClientSecret.label: Live Secret
liveClientSecret.help: The secret shown beside the live Client ID.

liveWebhookId.label: Live Webhook ID
liveWebhookId.help: The live app has its own webhook, with an ID different from the sandbox one.
